messages:
Lena (CSM): Heads-up — Sparrow AI is adding three new squads (search, support-bots, analytics). Sam says ramp starts next Monday. They’re looking at 3x token/day and want predictable p95 latency and guidance on Dedicated vs hosted optimizations.
Sam (Sparrow AI): Confirmed. Goal is 3x throughput by EOW. Favor dedicated pool if we can get predictable latency. Also want to discuss renewal terms — their renewal touchpoint is in ~6 weeks.
Diego (Solutions Eng): @Lena @Sam we can provision a temporary Dedicated pool for a month to validate. Need telemetry: p95, seq length distribution, tokens/session histogram. Can you attach a week of token hist?
Sam (Sparrow AI): Uploading a small CSV to the support portal but key numbers: current avg ~520k tokens/day -> forecast ~1.6M once squads onboard. p95 ~420ms on hosted right now.
Priya (Infra Eng): If they hit ~1.6M tokens/day with typical seq=1024, recommend 2 GPU nodes with aggressive batching. Quick suggestion to test:
```
batching:
  max_batch_size: 64
  max_wait_ms: 80
runtime:
  quantization: int8
```
Diego (Solutions Eng): Also recommend enabling prefix/KV caching for support-bots to save tokens. If they need <200ms p95 we should run a canary on Dedicated + routing policy. I can draft a canary plan.
Jo (RevOps): Flagging renewal risk — Sam said they'll look for a price lock if we provide Dedicated. I'll draft a short term-sheet with seat/commit options and possible promo for first 3 months.
OnboardingBot: Ticket #CS-4781 created: "Sparrow AI: multi-squad ramp — dedicated pool trial + canary plan" Assigned: Diego, Priya. ETA: 3 biz days.
Lena (CSM): Action items: 1) Diego -> canary + capacity proposal by Wed; 2) Priya -> infra cost estimate and perf knobs; 3) Jo -> renewal options draft; 4) Sam -> anonymized traces + token hist by EOD tomorrow.
Sam (Sparrow AI): We'll share anonymized traces and session hist by EOD tomorrow. No blockers on data sharing aside from PII scrub.
Diego (Solutions Eng): Thx. If possible run a 24h smoke against a test Dedicated pool with this curl to validate latency:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-13b", "input":"<bulk test payload>", "max_tokens":256 }'
```
Lena (CSM): Booking kickoff call for Fri 9am PT. Marked as high-priority on our side. :calendar: :rocket: 
Diego (Solutions Eng): I'll loop in support and eng-oncall after we get traces.
Priya (Infra Eng): I'll put rough cost estimates in the ticket and include ops-runbook checklist.
Jo (RevOps): Will sync with finance on potential promo approval and share term-sheet draft to this thread.
Lena (CSM): Great — will follow up after kickoff. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
